title: Impact of Recent Outbreaks at Hawker Centres on Infrastructure Enhancement of These Centres
what_it_is: Impact of Recent Outbreaks at Hawker Centres on Infrastructure Enhancement of These Centres

sections.label: Hawker Centres Transformation Programme
sections.summary: NEA announced the Hawker Centres Transformation Programme in March to ensure clean and safe hawker centre environments, with improvements implemented progressively at new and redeveloped centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Recognising the need to future-proof our hawker centres and markets to better deal with challenges such as COVID-19, the National Environment Authority (NEA) announced the development of the Hawker Centres Transformation Programme (HTP) in March this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The programme will focus on ensuring a clean and safe environment at hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Improvements will include better spacing of aisles and tables to minimise crowding, installation of high volume low-speed fans to improve ventilation and incorporation of food waste recycling systems, where feasible.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The programme will be progressively implemented at all new hawker centres and redeveloped centres.

sections.label: Toilet and productivity programmes
sections.summary: NEA launched the Hawker Centre Toilet Improvement Programme in 2020 and encourages hawker centres to join the Productive Hawker Centres programme for automated tray return and centralised dishwashing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA launched the Hawker Centre Toilet Improvement Programme (TIP) in 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The TIP offers co-funding for Town Councils to install better fittings and adopt technology which will make it easier to maintain and clean the toilets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: We will continue to encourage hawker centres to come on board the Productive Hawker Centres (PHC) programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: This programme offers funding assistance for the adoption of automated tray return systems and centralised dishwashing services, which improves productivity and enhances cleanliness and hygiene standards.

sections.label: Clearing trays made mandatory
sections.summary: Clearing dirty trays, crockery and litter has been mandatory since 21 June this year, with enforcement commencing only from 1 September.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: We urge everyone to do their part, including clearing their own dirty trays, crockery and litter.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: This has been made mandatory since 21 June this year but with enforcement commencing only from 1 September.
